name: Hero Slam variants deal their helper damage (Arcane, Shadow, Burning, Storm rank 2+, Brilliant)
contract: Arcane Slam 903100-903109, Shadow Slam 903110-903119, Burning Slam 903120-903129, Storm Slam ranks 2-10 903141-903149 and Brilliant Slam 907906-907915 are dummy-effect spells reading 'causing $9032xxs2% weapon damage plus $s1 ...strike damage. This uses Slam modifiers.'
Only stock Slam, Frozen Slam 903130-903139 and Storm Slam rank 1 903140 had spell_warr_slam, so the other ranks spent rage and dealt nothing.

Each tooltip names its helper: Arcane 903242 (school 65), Shadow 903243 (33), Burning 903244 (5), Storm 903246 (9), Brilliant 903247 (3), all WEAPON_DAMAGE bp -1 + 65% weapon damage taking the rank's dummy value as the flat bonus, like Frozen Slam's 903245.
Expected: one cast of a rank from each family (low, middle and top ranks, and Storm Slam rank 2) lands its helper exactly once and lowers the enemy's health.
